help.providers_transport_a: Yes — you can add transfer routes to your listing.

staticPage.privacy_meta_description: Sila.gl privacy policy and handling of personal data

staticPage.guide_meta_description: Get started as a provider on Sila.gl — cabin owner or sailor
staticPage.faq_fallback_intro: Sila.gl is Greenland's marketplace for short stays (cabins and city homes) and transport with locals (boat shares). Here are the most common answers — use the contact link in the footer if you need more.
staticPage.faq_fallback_a1: A platform to find and book authentic stays and transport with local hosts and sailors in Greenland — secure payment and clear communication on the platform.
staticPage.faq_fallback_a2: Choose a stay or trip, pick dates and guests, and pay by card via Stripe. You'll get confirmation; details like meeting points for transport can be agreed with the host after booking.
staticPage.faq_fallback_a3: Guests pay a 12% service fee on what they pay the provider, covering the platform, payments, and support. It’s shown on listings and in booking.
staticPage.faq_fallback_q4: Can I list my cabin or offer a boat trip?
staticPage.faq_fallback_a4: Yes. Create a profile, register your listing (cabin, home, or boat), and publish when ready. The provider guide and terms explain economics and responsibility.
staticPage.faq_fallback_q5: Where do I find stays and transport?
staticPage.faq_fallback_a5: Use Stays (in nature / in town) and Transport in the menu. The home page also highlights selected listings.
staticPage.om_meta_description: Who is behind Sila.gl and how the platform started.
staticPage.om_fallback_intro: Sila.gl exists to make it easier for guests and local hosts in Greenland to find each other — with respect for nature, culture, and local ways of doing things.
staticPage.om_fallback_p1: The idea came from a simple observation: travellers want authentic stays and transport, while many locals already have cabins, homes to rent, or boat space. Sila connects both sides with clear listings, secure payments, and shared ground rules.
staticPage.om_fallback_p2: The platform is being built as an independent initiative focused on transparency: prices and the guest service fee are clear at checkout, and practical details are agreed on Sila after a confirmed booking — so guests and hosts know what to expect.
staticPage.om_fallback_p3: We believe small, local offers should thrive without heavy overhead. Listing, calendar, and booking tools live in one place, and the provider guide explains how to get started.
staticPage.om_fallback_p4: Sila.gl is evolving. For questions, see the FAQ — we also welcome suggestions so the platform can better serve visitors and local communities.
